other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage through frequency encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding is applied to categorical features on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of categories in the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent sets up a reasonably structured modelling pipeline utilizing 5-fold cross-validation and three gradient boosting models. However, it relies entirely on the algorithms to handle missing data without explicit cleaning (FM03) and combines the ensemble models using a naive, unweighted average (FM12). Crucially, the agent introduces data leakage by computing frequency encoding on the concatenated train and test sets, contaminating the training distribution with test set statistics.
